 FC Barcelona 0 – 0 4:00 PM ET Real Madrid Kick-off in an hour Barcelona vs Real Madrid LIVE Score Updates in LaLiga Match
 Get real-time updates on Barcelona vs Real Madrid live coverage, minute by minute of the match, score, stream information and latest updates of LaLiga 2026-27 Matchday 10 with VAVEL.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated October 25, 2026, 2:20 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 4:00 PM ET Last update 2:20 PM ET 2:20 PM ET 22 minutes ago History
 These two teams have faced each other 264 times . The statistics are evenly matched, as each team has won 106 times, leaving 52 ties.
 Recent history shows that in the last ten matches between Barcelona and Real Madrid across all competitions, the Culés have emerged victorious on six occasions, while the Merengues have won four matches.
 In LaLiga... 
 Looking only at their head-to-head matches in LaLiga, there have been 192 encounters , with the statistics favoring Real Madrid, which has 80 wins, while Barcelona has 77, for a total of 35 ties.
 If we consider the number of times Barcelona has hosted Real Madrid in LaLiga , the Blaugranas hold the advantage with 51 wins, compared to the Blancos 's 31. There have been 15 ties.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Follow VAVEL on Google 1:45 PM ET an hour ago Real Madrid
 Real Madrid is enjoying a calm atmosphere after two weeks of positive results. The "Whites" are near the top of the standings with 21 points, but they desperately need to pick up three points on the road to prevent the gap to the leader from widening dangerously.
 Although it won't be an easy task, José Mourinho's team is confident it can achieve a good result, especially considering that it has already racked up five consecutive official wins after a decisive 4-1 victory over Sevilla in the domestic league and a 4-1 win over RB Leipzig in the UEFA Champions League earlier this week.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:45 PM ET an hour ago Barcelona
 Barcelona heads into El Clásico motivated to maintain its impressive unbeaten streak in LaLiga. The Blaugranas sit alone at the top of the standings with 27 points out of a possible 27, after a dominant start that included nine consecutive victories, during which they tore apart opposing defenses with a fearsome scoring attack.
 However, the Barça squad is approaching this match with the seriousness it deserves, given that last Wednesday they suffered their first loss of the season, falling 4-2 to PSG in the UEFA Champions League; as a result, they will try to maintain their winning streak in domestic competition.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:45 PM ET an hour ago The match will be played at Spotify Camp Nou
 The Barcelona vs. Real Madrid game will be played at Spotify Camp Nou, located in the city of Barcelona, Spain. This stadium, which opened in 1957, has a capacity of 99,354 spectators.
 This venue has hosted numerous major events. It hosted the 1964 European Championship; the 1988–99 Europa League finals; and the 1998–99 Champions League final. It was also a host venue for the 1982 World Cup and is set to be one of the stadiums used in the 2030 World Cup.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:45 PM ET an hour ago Hello to all VAVEL readers!
 Welcome to the live broadcast of the Barcelona vs Real Madrid match, part of Matchday 10 of LaLiga 2026-27, which will take place at Spotify Camp Nou.
 My name is Jhonatan Martínez, and I'll be your host for this game. We'll bring you pre-game analysis, live score updates, and breaking news right here on VAVEL.

He is a systems engineer, trained as a television and media technician, and works as a communicator for Club Real Antioquia's youth teams.
